import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style for the plots
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot for the amount by transaction type, separated by fraud status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', data=data, ci=None)

# Set the labels and title
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Average Transaction Amount', fontsize=14)
plt.title('Average Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=16)
plt.legend(title='Fraud Status', loc='upper right', labels=['Not Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
